name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan
drug_class: Anti-HER2 antibody–drug conjugate (topoisomerase I inhibitor payload)

discovery.note: Humanised anti-HER2 antibody joined by a cleavable tetrapeptide linker to deruxtecan (DXd), an exatecan derivative, with a drug-to-antibody ratio of about 8.

tagline: High-payload HER2 ADC that extended targeted therapy to HER2-low breast cancer
summary: Trastuzumab deruxtecan is an antibody–drug conjugate delivering a potent topoisomerase I inhibitor to HER2-expressing cells. It has shown large benefits in HER2-positive and HER2-low breast cancer and is approved in gastric, lung and other HER2-expressing solid tumours.
mechanism: The antibody binds HER2 and the conjugate is internalised; lysosomal enzymes cleave the linker, releasing DXd, which traps topoisomerase I–DNA complexes and causes lethal DNA damage.

DXd is membrane-permeable, so it can diffuse into neighbouring cells (bystander effect). Combined with the high drug-to-antibody ratio, this allows activity even in tumours with low or heterogeneous HER2 expression.
uses: HER2-low and HER2-ultralow metastatic breast cancer
HER2-positive gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
HER2-positive (IHC 3+) solid tumours after prior therapy (tumour-agnostic)

history.title: AstraZeneca partnership
history.detail: AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo agree to co-develop and co-commercialise the drug.

history.title: FDA accelerated approval
history.detail: Approved in December for HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer after two or more anti-HER2 regimens (DESTINY-Breast01).

history.title: HER2-low and lung cancer
history.detail: DESTINY-Breast04 establishes a new HER2-low category; approvals follow for HER2-low breast cancer and HER2-mutant NSCLC.

history.title: Tumour-agnostic approval
history.detail: FDA grants accelerated approval for HER2-positive (IHC 3+) solid tumours of any type.

history.title: HER2-ultralow
history.detail: Approved for HR-positive HER2-low and HER2-ultralow breast cancer after endocrine therapy (DESTINY-Breast06).

pk.metabolism: Antibody catabolised; DXd metabolised mainly by CYP3A4

serious: Interstitial lung disease and pneumonitis (sometimes fatal)
safety.boxed_warning: Interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis and embryo-fetal toxicity.

facts: Its DESTINY-Breast04 results created the clinical category 'HER2-low' breast cancer.
It is not interchangeable with trastuzumab or trastuzumab emtansine.
